verdict.rationale: Obsidian's Bases core plugin documents viewing, editing, sorting and filtering notes by their properties, including Kanban grouping by a property. Community users corroborate property-driven overviews (e.g., NPC attributes) and call Bases a fast ~90% Dataview replacement. However, the pack never documents typed property fields or tags themselves, so much of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documentation of typed property types (date/number/list etc.), any evidence of tag support and tag-based retrieval, and evidence of consistent property/tag management across the vault.
